prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one NEW transparent pixel-art rare-encounter character sprite for Black The Survival.
Draw a fresh original sprite, matching the game's compact cute chibi style: 2.1 to 2.3 heads tall, head about 43-47 percent of full height, broad rounded head, tiny compact torso, very short legs and small hands. Muted material colors, crisp dark-purple/brown one-pixel contours, selective colored interior outlines, deliberate square pixel clusters, about three flat shades per material and restrained highlights. Design for an 80 x 80 logical grid, with the entire character and prop fitting within about 72 x 72 pixels.
Keep each character's own recognizable face: readable distinct upper eyelids and 4-6-pixel irises, eyebrows, small mouth, restrained cheeks. Preserve character-specific eye shapes, age, facial hair, glasses and expression rather than repeating a generic face.
One full-body character only, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, a newly drawn balanced idle/battle-ready pose. Entire feet and signature prop visible, transparent padding on all sides. Square composition with a genuinely transparent background. No text, label, watermark, signature, scenery, floor, shadow, glow cloud, UI, frame, sprite sheet or additional characters. No smooth painting, anti-aliasing, gradients, 3D, realistic anatomy, long-legged body or weapon obscuring the face.
The user-provided Rio fan sprite is STYLE GUIDANCE ONLY: study compact proportions and pixel clustering, never trace its pixels, copy its pose, reproduce its sprite, watermark, bow or clothes. It must not become part of any shipped asset.

Input references, in this exact order:
Image 1: official selected skin appearance reference.
Image 2: official default identity reference; face and identity only, not outfit.
Image 3: style guidance only; user-provided fan art, not copied or redistributed.

Character: 니아 (nia).
Rare outfit: 니아 (물속성).
Outfit/weapon reference: Use the supplied official full-body skin illustration to preserve this skin's actual hair, distinctive face, costume palette, garment silhouette and signature prop; do not inherit the character's base outfit or another subject's accessories.
Character-specific face from the original: Sleepy adolescent gamer, HALF-CLOSED drooping upper eyelids, tiny dark-violet irises, low level eyebrows, unimpressed mouth with pink bubblegum bubble. No wide round eyes.
Recreate the selected skin's visible costume, color placements, hairstyle, accessories and weapon silhouette; the default reference must not override the skin outfit. Do not invent sunglasses, hats or props absent from the selected skin.

Selected skin details: lavender-pink high twin ponytails with two white scrunchies; oversized iridescent pink-purple swim goggles resting on the forehead; the white/lavender-and-black sporty halter swim top with small magenta pixel motifs and black swim bottoms with a tiny magenta cross. A small game device hangs at her hip. Hold one bright pink water pistol with a turquoise grip low at her side. Keep the sleepy half-closed eyes and a small pink bubblegum bubble. Simple pink sport sandals. A compact pink swim ring can sit behind her waist, leaving the face and hands clear. Nonsexual cute chibi presentation, flat simplified torso, no cleavage or anatomy emphasis. Do not copy the reclining pose, camera crop or background water effects of the skin reference; draw a new upright full-body idle pose.
processing: Original generated alpha preserved; alpha crop, nearest resize to fit 72px, transparent 80px padding, exact 2x nearest enlargement only.
